name: KiSignal-Guard
description: Intelligent High-Speed Signal Integrity (SI), EMC & Power Decoupling Linter for KiCad 9
description_full: KiSignal-Guard is an advanced KiCad 9 plugin that verifies electrical semantics: return path split-plane crossings, decoupling capacitor parasitic loop inductance, trace crosstalk (3W rule), differential pair skew, and thermal via density.
